Prevention of attacks of cluster headache (p.616) by repeated application of capsaicin to the nasal mucosa has been reported.1 The Z-isomer (zucapsaicin; civamide) has also been found to be modestly effective.2 Repeated nasal application of capsaicin has also been found to be effective in chronic migraine.3 1. Intravesical capsaicin has been tried for painful bladder disorders and to treat bladder detrusor hyper- reflexia.1-9 Results have been variable, and the characteristic sen- sory effects of capsaicin make blinding of studies difficult, but some patients have reported benefit particularly those with neu- rological bladder disorders.
